data.name: Place it Gently – Cozy Organizing
data.detailed_description:
Turn empty spaces into cozy places—one carefully placed object at a time.

In Place it Gently!, you step into a relaxing first-person decorating experience where every object has its perfect place. Pick up furniture, decorations, and everyday items, rotate them freely, and gently place them to transform empty places into warm and beautiful spaces.

There are no timers and no pressure—just calm, satisfying gameplay focused on creativity, organization, and the simple joy of making a place feel like home.

Take your time, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere, and create cozy environments that feel just right.

🧩 Features:

  • 👀 First-Person Interaction: Experience the environment from a first-person perspective, interacting with every item naturally and closely.

  • 🪑 Flexible Object Placement: Pick up, rotate, and gently place objects until everything feels perfectly arranged.

  • 🏡 Cozy Atmosphere: Decorate charming spaces filled with warm lighting, soft colors, and relaxing vibes.

  • 🎨 Surface painting: look at any wall or floor to open a color panel and make it your own.

  • 💾 Automatic saving: every item placed and every color chosen is saved instantly, no manual save needed.

  • 🔓 Gentle progression: complete a room to unlock the next, and revisit any finished space whenever you want.

  • 🌿 Relaxing Gameplay: No timers, no stress—just a peaceful experience focused on creativity and comfort.

    Take your time, relax, and enjoy creating spaces that feel just right.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: i5-4590 / Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 / R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or high (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: i5-10600 / Ryzen 5 3600 or high
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 / RX 580 or high
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or equivalent Linux distribution
  • Processor: i5-4590 / Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 / R9 390
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: i5-10600 / Ryzen 5 3600 or high
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 / RX 580 or high
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
